description: Fetch the full detail record of a pull request (title, body, state, branches, draft, author, timestamps), plus `mergeable` (true / false / null unknown) and `mergeState` from the same conflict probe the merge gate uses: status up-to-date | clean | conflicts | unknown, the unresolved files with their kinds, the files the merge rules settle, and conflictsUrl. Authenticated callers only (the read tool surface still works anonymously).
